items.subject: Fast Track Designation pathway
items.statement: Fast Track pathway has a timeline estimate of 3-5 years.

items.statement: Accelerated Approval pathway has a timeline estimate of 2-3 years.

items.subject: Regulatory team recommendation
items.statement: The Regulatory team recommends pursuing Fast Track Designation based on the strength of existing clinical and nonclinical data.

items.subject: mRNA-4157/V940 regulatory strategy
items.statement: Execute the following next steps in order: Submit Type B meeting request to FDA by 16 October 2026; Prepare Briefing Document with clinical and nonclinical data package; Engage external regulatory consultants for FDA interaction strategy; Brief Senior Leadership on regulatory pathway recommendation.

Submit Type B meeting request to FDA by 16 October 2026
Prepare Briefing Document with clinical and nonclinical data package

items.subject: FDA alignment risk mitigation
items.statement: Pre-submission meeting to align on endpoints is the mitigation strategy for the high-likelihood risk that FDA may not agree with surrogate endpoint.
